description: Markdown to editable PowerPoint, Word and PDF for AI agents, and checks of RDLC and RDL reports. convert_report writes a .pptx PowerPoint edits as its own (title placeholders, bullets and numbering, tables, Mermaid diagrams as shapes and connectors, speaker notes), a flowing .docx (Word's headings, paragraphs, tables and shapes) or a PDF from Markdown or a Marp deck; validate_report and render_preview check a report or a deck and show its pages. Local, over stdio: no service, no model; a report's code runs restricted, in a process of its own.
title: SSRS2 MCP server
